args: BIN="./bin/gateway-platform-mcp"; HTTP_BIN="./bin/gateway-platform-http"; if [ ! -x "$BIN" ] || [ ! -x "$HTTP_BIN" ] || [ ./build.sh -nt "$BIN" ] || [ ./go.mod -nt "$BIN" ] || [ ./go.sum -nt "$BIN" ] || [ ./main.go -nt "$BIN" ] || find ./cmd ./internal ./server ./frontend -type f -newer "$BIN" -print -quit | grep -q .; then bash ./build.sh; fi; exec "$BIN"
